Every moment has its own story. Some are seen, others are felt. From the richness of local culture and vibrant colours to the ocean breeze and the quiet moments in between, every destination offered a different perspective. And for me, the beauty of travelling has always been about capturing those moments as authentically as possible. This journey, I brought along the OPPO Find X10 Pro Max to explore a new perspective on mobile cinematography. Shooting in OpenGate with O-Log2 gave me the creative freedom to capture more of every scene, with greater flexibility to colour grade and reframe my footage in post-production. Whether creating vertical Reels or cinematic travel films, I could shape each story without compromising my creative vision. What impressed me most was how naturally everything came together. From the vibrant colours of my surroundings to the subtle details in skin tones, every frame felt true to the moments I experienced. Because great storytelling isn’t just about how beautiful a scene looks. It’s about how it makes you feel, even long after the moment has passed.
